cap.idsa.out_healthy: For an outpatient without comorbidity amoxicillin comes first; doxycycline, or a macrolide where local resistance is below 25%, are alternatives. At least 5 days, until clinically stable.
cap.idsa.out_healthy_resistant: Local pneumococcal macrolide resistance is 25% or higher, so macrolide monotherapy is not advised; amoxicillin or doxycycline.
cap.idsa.out_comorbid: With comorbidity: a beta-lactam (amoxicillin-clavulanate or a cephalosporin) plus a macrolide or doxycycline, or a respiratory fluoroquinolone alone.
cap.idsa.ward: Non-severe inpatient: a beta-lactam plus a macrolide, or a respiratory fluoroquinolone alone; beta-lactam plus doxycycline when both are contraindicated.
cap.idsa.severe: Severe CAP: a beta-lactam plus a macrolide, or a beta-lactam plus a respiratory fluoroquinolone.
cap.idsa.mrsa_prior: Prior respiratory MRSA: add anti-MRSA cover and obtain cultures and nasal PCR; 7 days.
cap.idsa.mrsa_recent: Severe CAP after recent hospitalisation with IV antibiotics: add anti-MRSA cover and obtain cultures.
cap.idsa.psa_prior: Prior respiratory P. aeruginosa: switch the beta-lactam to an antipseudomonal agent; 7 days.
cap.idsa.psa_recent: Severe CAP after recent hospitalisation with IV antibiotics: use an antipseudomonal beta-lactam and obtain cultures.
cap.idsa.recent_nonsevere: Non-severe patient with recent hospitalisation: obtain cultures; add MRSA or Pseudomonas cover only if cultures are positive.
cap.note.out_resistant: The guideline does not address outpatients with a resistant-pathogen history; admission and cultures are a clinical decision.
cap.idsa.aspiration: Suspected aspiration does not call for routine anaerobic cover.
cap.idsa.abscess: Lung abscess or empyema: choose a beta-lactam that covers anaerobes.
cap.idsa.influenza: Influenza positive: add oseltamivir; standard antibacterial treatment is also started.
cap.ttd.out_comorbid: TTD: with comorbidity an oral cephalosporin or amoxicillin-clavulanate plus a macrolide comes first; fluoroquinolones are a later tier because they may mask tuberculosis (uncertain).
cap.ttd.ward: TTD: on the ward a beta-lactam plus a macrolide comes first; fluoroquinolone monotherapy is a later tier (uncertain).
cap.ttd.psa_fq: TTD: with Pseudomonas risk, levofloxacin is added to the antipseudomonal beta-lactam (uncertain).
